ic_device.name: TL431
ic_device.description: Three-terminal adjustable shunt regulator with specified thermal stability; output voltage settable from Vref (~2.5V) to 36V with two external resistors.

pins.name: CATHODE
pins.description: Shunt current/voltage input/output node of the shunt regulator

pins.name: ANODE
pins.description: Common pin, normally connected to ground
pins.evidence: Common pin, normally connected to ground

port_dependencies.condition: >1mA (Imin(max)) must be supplied into the cathode pin
Feedback from Cathode and Ref pins creates replica of internal reference voltage; IREF ≥ 4µA required

functional_blocks.name: Internal Reference and Amplifier
functional_blocks.description: Accurate voltage reference and opamp; outputs sink current based on difference between reference pin and virtual internal pin via Darlington pair.
